hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *index.html) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cur=$(sed -n "s/.*APP_VERSION:[[:space:]]*'\([0-9.]*\)'.*/\1/p" "$f" | head -1); rootdir=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); rel=${f#"$rootdir/"}; com=$(git -C "$rootdir" show HEAD:"$rel" 2>/dev/null | sed -n "s/.*APP_VERSION:[[:space:]]*'\([0-9.]*\)'.*/\1/p" | head -1); if [ "$cur" = "$com" ]; then new=$(printf "%.2f" "$(echo "$cur + 0.01" | bc)"); sed -i "s/APP_VERSION:[[:space:]]*'$cur'/APP_VERSION:    '$new'/" "$f"; printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"APP_VERSION was not updated — I have auto-incremented it from %s to %s. Please tell Gareth the app is now v%s."}}' "$cur" "$new" "$new"; else printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"APP_VERSION is v%s (was v%s at last commit). Please mention version v%s to Gareth in your response."}}' "$cur" "$com" "$cur"; fi; }
